title: Relevance
listing_description: An account of what matters when AI makes plausible creation abundant, shifting the bottleneck from producing candidates to judging, testing, comparing, and sustaining them.
reader_hook: Explore why relevance is a relationship rather than a universal score, and how research, culture, design, and institutions can choose responsibly amid abundance.

source_excerpt.end_heading: 2. Research: The First Laboratory of Relevance
